phase: comparison completed after persisted fresh observations
disclosure: Reviewer already knows the Wish and concept. All four current image files were freshly opened once in round4. These observations are informed, not blind. Prior round2 blind and round3 reports remain historical and unmodified.

fresh_images.read: A pale umbrella-bell object stands on a narrow central column over a round foot. Several long pearl-colored segmented strands surround blue and pink inner ribbons. The broad crown is flat, the skirt flares smoothly and its rim has shallow scallops. Sparse dark pinpricks appear on the shell, but no large triangular patches or transparent surface failures are visible.

The left object has nearly vertical upper suspension arms and closely gathered hanging strands. In the right panel the bell sits lower relative to the unchanged foot, the pale-blue annular mechanism also appears lower, suspension arms angle outward, and strand endpoints rise while the outer envelope widens. Inner ribbons remain central. The two states visibly differ without any shown movement between them.

The close view shows an opaque cream-white shell, continuous soft shading along a scalloped sloping skirt, a distinct flat crown transition, and one pink and one pale-blue narrow accent region on the front. The shell edge is visually thin. Surface pinpricks remain tiny and sparse. No gross cracks, missing regions, protruding shards or triangular patchwork are visible.

Opposite low views expose hollow canopy edge, annular underbell linkage and central stand. Eight peripheral strands can be tracked as four projected front/back pairs using their separate bead sequences and terminal beads. Four wavy inner ribbons are distinguishable: two pink and two blue. The footer states exact pressed CAD height 113.6 mm and width 102.1 mm. The right view is darker but its outlines remain readable; upper hidden internal clearance is not measurable from these views.

boolean_evidence.held_object_unmistakable: The current isometric view reads as a jellyfish-like mechanical desk companion: a bell above a tentacle corona, inner ribbons and a supporting pedestal.
boolean_evidence.form_matches_wish: Fresh views show a smooth-looking thin pale shell, shallow scallops, pastel accents, narrow stand, long segmented peripheral strands and central ribbons.
boolean_evidence.subjects_match_wish: Fresh opposite underside views resolve eight beaded strand sequences and four inner ribbons, within a single jellyfish object.
boolean_evidence.action_matches_wish: Static association only: the lower-bell panel has lower annular linkage, outward upper arms and a wider, slightly lifted tentacle skirt.
boolean_evidence.relationship_matches_wish: Peripheral strands visibly attach to arms under the bell; the inner ribbon group occupies the center around the stand and common ring.
boolean_evidence.anti_generic_signature_visible: The two authored states show a specific press-associated jellyfish transformation with linked repeated beads and distinct wavy inner ribbons; the signature is visible beyond surface decoration.
boolean_evidence.signature_experience_unmistakable: The intended gathered-to-flared transformation is unambiguous in the paired stills. This boolean refers to the depicted experience only; actual press feel, release, wind-up and swimming motion are unverified.
boolean_evidence.finished_product_desirable: As an independent image-based aesthetic judgment, the restrained pearl/pastel palette, scalloped skirt and repeated strands form an appealing desk automaton with a clear broad press surface. No physical-product finish or human-response test is implied.
